candidate.title: Relationship-selected XML parts bypass admission depth limits and reach the recursive renderer parser
candidate.attacker: An attacker who supplies a DOCX to a user or service that renders it to PDF or PNG.
candidate.violated_security_invariant: Every untrusted XML part passed to the permissive recursive DOM parser must first satisfy the active XML depth and tag budgets.
candidate.source_to_sink: admit scans XML only when a ZIP name ends in .xml or .rels (src/admission.rs:533-550), with a second special check only for the main document (556-569). An internal styles relationship may target word/styles.bin; main_rel_part resolves it without restricting the suffix (src/convert/mod.rs:21310-21319). load_stylesheet reads it and calls dom.parse_xdocument without checking limits (3480,3496-3497). Parser::parse_element recursively invokes itself for every child (src/xmllinq/parse.rs:660-662) without a depth check. An otherwise ordinary Transitional DOCX containing a deeply nested styles.bin therefore passes admission and drives unbounded call-stack recursion. The same established sibling sink exists for the relationship-selected theme part: load_theme -> parse_theme_xml (3305-3317).
candidate.impact: A small compressed document can abort a native CLI/Python service with stack overflow or trap a WASM renderer, denying document processing. Process CPU/memory limits do not restore the bypassed XML refusal and Rust stack overflow is not an ordinary recoverable conversion error.
counterevidence: The renderer explicitly calls admit_package before opening (src/convert/mod.rs:773-777); conventional .xml/.rels targets and a nonstandard main part are checked.
Archive byte and entry budgets remain effective; these do not bound XML nesting in a nonstandard auxiliary part.
main_rel_part refuses explicit External targets, and no network request is needed for this attack.
The permissive DOM parser is intentionally unchecked; the vulnerability is its reachable unchecked use on a relationship target missed by admission, not its documented raw API alone.
candidate.recommended_remediation: Before each renderer DOM construction, use try_parse_xdocument_with_limits with the active limits, or admit all relationship/content-type identified XML parts regardless of filename suffix. Add integration regressions for over-depth styles/theme parts named .bin and verify the ordinary INVALID_XML refusal on PDF and PNG paths.

candidate.originalEvidence: Confirmed a promising WMF record-boundary flaw: record size is checked only against overall buffer; TEXTOUT/EXTTEXTOUT and polygon counts read subsequent records as payload. Repeated tiny records can repeatedly materialize 65,535-byte text or 65,535-point polygons from shared trailing bytes, causing major amplification below ZIP admission. Verifying concrete construction and sibling controls; also reviewing legacy length/count logic and font/relationship paths.

candidate.title: UTF-16 XML bypasses redaction leak checks and preserves the supposedly removed text
candidate.attacker: A document producer who embeds a duplicate of text that a recipient will redact, or a recipient of an exported document containing such a duplicate.
candidate.violated_security_invariant: A successful redact edit must refuse output while the redacted text remains recoverable in any package part.
candidate.source_to_sink: Admission explicitly accepts BOM-marked UTF-16LE/BE XML by decoding it before validation (src/admission.rs:768-791). A valid customXml/item1.xml can contain the same secret as a main-document paragraph in UTF-16. The edit changes the paragraph and preserves the unrelated custom XML bytes. check_redactions scans both output packages via scrub::leaks and accepts when that returns empty (src/edit.rs:4727-4737; src/edit/prepared.rs:803-804). leaks_within routes .xml/.rels entries through String::from_utf8_lossy (src/scrub.rs:467-471). This yields replacement characters and NUL-interleaved text, not the XML's decoded content. xml_holds' no-root fallback then only tests xml.contains(needle) (529-532). The UTF-16LE byte-pattern scan is applied only to non-XML names, so the duplicate remains invisible to the final safety gate.
candidate.impact: The clean/redline DOCX can be reported as successfully redacted while its custom XML retains the original secret in a readily decodable form; a recipient can unzip and recover it.
counterevidence: The leak scanner checks both output packages, bounds archive inflation and fails closed on archive/read errors.
It detects UTF-8 XML entities, split Word text runs, and raw UTF-16LE in non-XML parts; existing tests at src/scrub.rs:667-735 establish those controls but omit UTF-16 XML.
This does not require an invalid XML part: admission intentionally transcodes UTF-16 customXml inputs.
candidate.recommended_remediation: Share the XML decoder used by admission with the leak scanner, decode UTF-16LE and UTF-16BE before xml_holds, and refuse unrecognized/invalid encodings rather than silently classifying them as clean. Preserve raw-byte checks as defense in depth. Add redaction tests proving a UTF-16 customXml duplicate causes REDACTION_LEAK and no artifact is returned.

candidate.originalEvidence: font_table::load_embedded_fonts eagerly loops every attacker-controlled distinct font name, resolves each embedRegular to package bytes, deobfuscate_odttf calls bytes.to_vec(), Face::parse validates, then stores a new owned copy by (name,bold,italic). Thousands of unique aliases referencing the same valid 1 MiB font create thousands of MiB despite small admitted package; no used-family filter or per-target cache.

public markdown_to_docx -> package::assemble opens options.reference via PartFs::open, never calls admission or checked XML (markdown/write.rs:60-109; markdown/package.rs:107-129). frame(source) calls final_section -> Dom::parse_xdocument of the reference main document at package.rs:545-547. Unlike renderer suffix issue, a conventional word/document.xml with deep nesting reaches recursion directly; no admission even checks its name. Python native markdown_to_docx passes caller reference through at jubarte-python/src/lib.rs:1206-1223; WASM markdownToDocx similarly. PartFs::open only ZIP budgets. This deserves separate finding/remediation: admit reference at public Markdown entry before read/assemble.
